metadata.title: Vibrant Soul Portrait with Beaded Braids

recipe.visualDefinition: A close-up, low-angle oil-painted portrait of a Black man with long beaded braids and red aviator sunglasses, set against a fiery orange-to-red gradient background framed by a jagged green border on a black field.
coreVisualRelationships: The warm skin tones and background create a monochromatic heat effect.
The intricate, multi-colored beads contrast against the smooth skin and flat background.
The jagged green border acts as a vibrant separator between the central art and the black outer frame.
coreInvariants: Low-angle perspective looking up at the subject.
Visible sweat droplets on the forehead and cheeks.
Red-rimmed aviator sunglasses with a distinct lens flare.
Symmetrical arrangement of beaded braids framing the face.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central, large-scale portrait occupying 80% of the inner frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The red aviator sunglasses and the lens flare on the right lens.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the eyes/sunglasses, moves down the nose to the open mouth, then outward to the beaded braids, and finally to the text at the top and bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Solid black outer margin provides high-contrast breathing room for the central artwork.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm oranges and reds (background and skin tones).
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Yellow and white (bead highlights, lens flare, and typography).
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the central frame; high value contrast between the yellow text and black background.

letterConstructionRules: Fluid, hand-painted brush strokes with varying thickness.
Connected lowercase letters with expressive, detached uppercase initials.
Yellow fill with a slight drop shadow or dark outline for legibility.
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'S' and 'W' have elongated, sweeping tails.
The 'H' and 'T' in the bottom text feature sharp, energetic crossbars.

composition.relationshipToImage: Placed on the black outer frame, framing the central artwork.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Consistent hand-painted script used for both top and bottom text blocks to maintain a unified artist-brand identity.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the fluid, painterly motion of the original lettering.
Matches the casual but professional hand-rendered look.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create an oil painting of a Black man from a low angle, wearing red aviator sunglasses with a lens flare. He has long braids decorated with many colorful beads. His skin is glistening with sweat. The background is a warm orange-to-red gradient. The entire image is enclosed in a thin, jagged green border, which is then surrounded by a thick black frame.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add hand-painted, yellow script lettering centered in the black space above and below the green border. The top text should be larger than the bottom text.

verificationChecks: Is the perspective a low-angle looking up?
Are the sunglasses red-rimmed with a visible flare?
Is the green border jagged and hand-drawn?
Is the text yellow and in a brush-script style?

adjustableVariables: Density and color variety of the beads
Thickness of the black outer frame
mustRedesign: Specific facial features to avoid likeness
Original brush stroke patterns in the lettering
postGenerationChecks: Check for the presence of the jagged green border.
Ensure the sunglasses have a distinct lens flare.
Verify the text is yellow script on a black background.
recipe.reuseFormula: Oil-painted portrait + low-angle perspective + warm gradient background + jagged color border + black outer frame + yellow brush-script typography.
